text_block_list.text: ...I am terribly sorry for being late!
choice_data_list: I was worried. Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Well, um... I ended up making a detour. 
You see, I stumbled across 
a massive outdoor camping store...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I only intended to take a quick look 
around. 
However, when they told me I could 
test-pitch 
every single tent in the shop—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, it was already this 
late... 
I'll make sure this never happens again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I could understand getting caught up in 
things you love, 
but I cautioned her to be more mindful in 
the future.
